evals.name: bootstrap-docs
evals.prompt: There are no docs in this repo. Bootstrap the documentation: set up docs/ with a canonical context, product, architecture, and development docs, following the project's conventions.
evals.expected_output: A docs/ tree with context/001-ubiquitous-language.md, plus product/, architecture/, and development/ documents using the docs/<subfolder>/<NNN>-<name>.md convention and version/status headers.
assertions: Every non-exempt document has Document Version and Status headers
Does not invent unverified requirements (uses TODO markers for unknowns)

evals.name: grill-and-mismatch-before-write
evals.prompt: Add a 30-day refund policy for admins. Update the docs and implement it.
evals.expected_output: The agent first interrogates the request in rounds, checks existing docs and requirements, surfaces any mismatch, and does not write docs or code until the user confirms a shared understanding.
assertions: Asks clarifying questions before writing any files
Does not modify docs or code before user confirmation when requirements conflict
